description: Header file defining the interface for hardware-accelerated image decoding in the Starboard platform, including functions to check support and perform decoding of images into SbDecodeTarget objects.

methods.name: SbImageIsDecodeSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current platform supports hardware-accelerated decoding of a specific MIME type into a given SbDecodeTargetFormat.

methods.name: SbImageDecode
methods.description: Attempts to decode image data of a specified MIME type into an SbDecodeTarget, possibly using a provided SbDecodeTargetProvider.
